An '''assassin probe''' was smuggled onto the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] during its voyage to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], to [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|assassinate]] [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. It was the first to be defeated by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his unit of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].
